name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport logistics began unexpectedly. After years managing supply chains for a large electronics manufacturer in Shenzhen, he volunteered to help a local amateur racing team with their transportation and inventory. His meticulous approach and problem-solving skills quickly impressed the team, leading to a full-time offer. He joined Rexal FMI Racing five years ago, and has become an invaluable member, orchestrating the complex movement of equipment and personnel across continents with impressive efficiency. 

Li's focus is always on anticipating potential issues and proactively implementing solutions. He excels at negotiating with suppliers and customs officials, ensuring that everything arrives on time and within budget. While he's not always the most vocal member of the team, his quiet dedication and unwavering commitment to excellence make him a highly respected and relied-upon figure. He is known for his ability to remain calm under pressure, a crucial asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport logistics.

physical.description: A medium-build man with a calm and focused demeanor, Li carries himself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations, even though he has a calculator.
Insists on drinking green tea at precisely 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM every day.
